about: Facts that live in more than one file. When a file of a group is edited, the agent hook (tools/doc_links.py) names the other files of that group. 'truth' is where the fact comes from; 'copies' repeat it. Paths are globs from the repository root. tests/test_doc_links.py checks that every glob matches a file.

groups.name: Load Looks menu path and options
groups.fact: MENU → SETUP → Custom Menu → J → Load Looks → Load, and the row's options (Off / Load, no Built-in)

groups.name: Custom Menu tab missing
groups.fact: No gears tab: MENU → SETUP → Setup Menu (wrench tab) → Menu Display → Custom Menu → On

groups.name: Film catalogue
groups.fact: The films, their count, names, notes, and the Olympus art filter of each ART entry
regenerate: uv run python web/scripts/export_films.py (film-records.json from catalogue.json)
uv run epm2mod generate (the film table in docs/guide/film-looks.md)

groups.name: Flash procedure
groups.fact: Card in, hold OK and ON/OFF, steady lamp 1 to 2 minutes, blinking lamp = done, restart
regenerate: uv run epm2mod generate (the camera steps in README.md)

groups.name: Pinned build
groups.fact: Which build is pinned and what it does (today: Olympus art filters kept, films loaded from the card)
regenerate: uv run epm2mod generate (docs/install.md and builds/README.md blocks)

groups.name: Installer launch steps
groups.fact: Start (Mac).command / Start (Windows).bat / start.sh, Gatekeeper Open Anyway, the first start downloads Python

groups.name: Command-line install
groups.fact: git clone, uv, epm2mod install / films / films set / restore / inspect / cards and their options
regenerate: uv run epm2mod generate (docs/cli.md, from the command definitions)

groups.name: Feature list
groups.fact: What EPM2Mod adds: film simulations, looks from the card, interval shooting, level gauge, focus peaking, debug log, lowest shutter speed
